purpose: Cross-compile the authoritative non-desktop SNES runtime floor required around the generated Uniracers guest before attempting a full Switch link.
acceptance: every declared runtime-floor source exists in the pinned framework
none of the declared sources is under runner/src/desktop
every declared source compiles with devkitA64 and __SWITCH__ defined
no Switch-specific simulation source fork is introduced
runtime-floor compilation does not require runner/src/desktop merely to satisfy config.h
non_claims: This is a compile gate, not a successful runtime link
This does not supply host contracts such as audio locks, draw callbacks, directories, or failure reporting
This does not run the guest on Switch hardware
This does not prove deterministic parity
This does not close Gate S2

boundary_headers.variables.h: Scaffold-required title header; empty until named WRAM declarations are added.
boundary_headers.config.h: common_rtl.c includes the desktop config contract but references no Config fields; the probe supplies an empty header instead of importing desktop SDL configuration.
